subject.title: feat(diagnostics-otel): identify each instance with service.instance.id

question: Should diagnostics-otel accept a new `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` plus hostname fallback contract, or should instance identity be supplied through standard OTel resource attributes and the canonical OpenClaw identity design?
rationale: The PR is mechanically small, but it chooses a user-facing telemetry identity contract and default value that affects operator configuration, privacy, and grouping semantics.

options.title: Align With Standard OTel Resource Identity
options.body: Remove the custom env variable and hostname fallback, then use `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` or the identity source approved in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93071 before merge.

options.title: Adopt The New Env Contract
options.body: Accept `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` only after adding docs, precedence rules, privacy expectations, and real exported-resource proof.

options.title: Pause For Canonical Issue
options.body: Keep this PR blocked while the canonical issue settles the durable service/version/instance identity contract.

recommendation.title: Align With Standard OTel Resource Identity
recommendation.body: Remove the custom env variable and hostname fallback, then use `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` or the identity source approved in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93071 before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the diagnostics-otel exporter and is the strongest history-backed routing candidate for a plugin identity contract decision.
